text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
choice_data_list: Good work. That was a great race!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! I believe I was able 
to run a race that the children can look 
up to.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However, to let victory slip away when we 
were just one step away... is utterly 
heartbreaking!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that I could have shown the 
children a cooler side of myself makes 
this truly disappointing...
choice_data_list: It's okay. You looked so cool out there

If that's how you feel, let's prepare for 
next time.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Hearing you say that is very encouraging.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even so... I still want to show a side of 
myself that people can truly look up to.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Boss! Let's show the kids 
the coolest version of me once more!
